from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
import hashlib
import re
import subprocess

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1"
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def ref(p):
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def save(name,d):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("完成产物已存在，禁止覆盖："+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return ref(p)
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
resultpath=out/"result.json"
assert sha(resultpath.read_bytes())=="1683643e22cddaa3c6a9032fbf346bc6e9e7d03285836d36eb832122f6ac3515"

旧E120的156既用日期和23条件对象关闭事实不改，所有旧拒绝及其他研究线各自保持。当前已准入下一金融候选0，E122未提案未登记；不能以新字段名称或改来源钟伪装成新的合格实验。
